nary_nodes.label: European Drought
evidence: Drought conditions have worsened across Central and Western Europe since the start of the summer with southern England, northern Italy and parts of Central Europe among the hardest-hit areas, according to the Global Drought Observatory.

About half of Europe’s land area is experiencing drought with 9 percent reaching the alert level, including southern Germany, Hungary, Romania, Austria, the Czech Republic and Slovakia, according to the Combined Drought Indicator for mid-July.

nary_nodes.label: Loire River Level Decrease
evidence: The Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels after continued hotter and drier conditions.
A time-series comparison of satellite images of the Loire River near the French city of Saumur shows a clear change in the shape of the river channel during August from 2023 to 2026.

nary_nodes.label: Po River Level Decrease
evidence: The Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels after continued hotter and drier conditions.
Images of the Po River near Boretto in the Emilia-Romagna region show changes in the extent of water and exposed areas during August in 2023 and 2026.

nary_nodes.label: Rhine River Level Decrease
evidence: The Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels after continued hotter and drier conditions.
Comparisons of satellite images taken near Kaub show an expansion of exposed sandy and gravelly areas within the Rhine River channel from May 1 to July 29.

nary_nodes.label: Danube River Level Decrease
evidence: The Loire, Po, Rhine and Danube rivers had reached record-low levels after continued hotter and drier conditions.
Satellite imagery showed a noticeable decline in water levels from August 9, 2025, to August 9, 2026.

nary_nodes.label: Drought Impact on England
evidence: England recorded just 6.5mm (a quarter of an inch) of rainfall in July, equivalent to 10 percent of the long-term average, making it the driest July since records began in 1836.

On Tuesday, the United Kingdom’s Environment Agency announced that 71.3 percent of England was officially in drought, including all areas of Greater London, while reservoir storage had fallen to 69 percent.

nary_nodes.label: Garonne River Management Authority Statement
evidence: In early July, the Garonne River management authority began an early operation to support river levels, describing it as the earliest such intervention since the system was introduced in 1993 after river flows near Toulouse approached record-low levels for that time of year.

type_definitions.definition: A large area of land that is separated from other areas by oceans or seas.

A natural flowing body of water that often connects lakes, wetlands, and the ocean.
A large human settlement that is usually defined as a local government area.
A group of people that work together to achieve a common goal or purpose.
A period of 365 or 366 days, used to measure time.
A specific point in time, usually represented by a day, month, and year.
A prolonged period of abnormally low rainfall, leading to water scarcity.
A decrease in the water level of a river, often caused by drought or human activities.
